LanguageData.CK_Description: After a successful skip abduction, the invoker carries the victim away while the other cultists escort them. If interrupted, the nearest capable cultist takes over.
LanguageData.CK_EnableRepeat: Send another skip abduction raid after a successful kidnapping
LanguageData.CK_EnableRepeatTip: Each successful escape with a victim can trigger another raid. Disabling this cancels pending follow-up raids; cultists still attempt to carry victims away.
LanguageData.CK_IntervalTip: A random whole number of days, from 1 to 30. Changes apply to future kidnappings. Each map has at most one pending follow-up. If vanilla currently prevents the raid, it retries hourly.
LanguageData.CK_Pursuit: The cultists are carrying {PAWN_nameDef} away! Stop the carrier before they leave the map.
